name: writing-emit
description: Deterministic emitter core for the writing repo's blog drafts. Resolves a canonical, portable draft.md (inlining file= snippets, regenerating LikeC4 PNGs) and FLATTENS its rich constructs (::::journey, :::callouts, likec4= images) into target-flavored Markdown, so a self-contained dist/<slug>.md can be delivered to a downstream target (Google Docs today). Reuses the two target-agnostic remark plugins from ../preview/src/plugins/ verbatim — one implementation of the snippet extraction and the prose guard. NEVER edits draft.md.
